request.prompt:
Create one isolated full-body production prototype for the Mass Effect Armax Relay Clash asset collection, faithfully reproducing the specific original game creature in the attached artist reference. Follow the actual model anatomy, proportions, surface details, colors, materials, and asymmetries. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, neutral studio illumination. Output exactly ONE creature and ONE view, not a reference sheet. The complete head, every crest and limb, all hands and feet must fit inside the canvas with at least 6 percent transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no floor shadow, no scenery, no labels, no text, no logo. No redesign, no invented equipment, no extra body parts, no particle effects. Preserve model-side asymmetry and do not mirror the reference. This is one static pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: the standard kett Fiend from Mass Effect: Andromeda, using the finalized IN-GAME model with metal forearm equipment shown in the attached artist sheet. Use the LEFTMOST figure as the pose authority: massive hunched quadrupedal body, head aimed slightly toward image-left, with the creature's complete silhouette shown from a front three-quarter angle. Match pale gray coarse bone-like plates across the broad shoulders and upper arms, jagged layered head crest, small deeply set eyes, uneven tooth-lined alien jaw, very dark charcoal folded abdominal hide, restrained dark red organic seams. Both long forearms retain their actual olive-green mechanical bracers and small violet-blue luminous nodes near the wrists and knuckles. Preserve the bracers' exact side-specific layout; no extra armor. Massive hands and short hind feet must all remain within the frame. Preserve the original creature proportions and low grounded pose; no weapons, no special effects.
